name: MiniGS Auxiliary & Depth Rendering Interface
definition: Validation and dispatch layer for MiniGS-specific rasterizer entry points that return auxiliary statistics for blur-aware splitting and depth back-sampling.
summary: The MiniGS Auxiliary & Depth Rendering Interface is a validation layer for training that returns auxiliary statistics for blur-aware splitting and depth back-sampling, distinct from standard rendering by enforcing gradient-bearing attribute preconditions.
